author: IGN
description:
'There is no light where we’re going.' Check out the teaser trailer for Verity, an upcoming movie starring Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson, and Josh Hartnett. 

Struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh is hired as a ghostwriter for renowned author Verity Crawford under mysterious circumstances, but her assignment takes a dark turn after discovering chilling autobiographical notes. Faced with a series of deadly family secrets, Lowen struggles to separate fiction from reality, while also blurring the lines with Verity’s husband, Jeremy.

Verity is produced by Nick Antosca, Alex Hedlund, Stacey Sher, Michael Showalter, Jordana Mollick, Anne Hathaway, and Colleen Hoover.

Verity, directed by Michael Showalter, opens in theaters on October 2, 2026.
title: Verity - Official Teaser Trailer (2026) Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson, Josh Hartnett

description:
Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes is a dark atmospheric adventure‑puzzle game where you embody Dark Six, a mysterious figure with the shape of a little girl. Navigate in a disturbing world, solve intricate puzzles, and escape terrifying giant foes in a desperate search to become whole again.

Played on PC with NVIDIA RTX 4090

#littlenightmares #vrgames #littlenightmaresvr

author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the Overview and Quick Start Guide Video for the Steam Controller, the new PC controller developed by Valve. Players can get the rundown on setting up, updating, and using the Steam Controller and Steam Puck across Steam games. Explore what's in store for the Steam Controller, launching on May 4 on Steam.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Steam Controller - Official Overview and Quick Start Guide

author: IGN
description: Valve's new iteration of the Steam Controller is just over the horizon. We sat down with some of the creators of the Steam Controller to discuss how they landed on the Steam Controller price, what players can expect when playing their keyboard and mouse dedicated games, and more. Additionally, Valve talks about the latest on where they're at with Steam Deck 2 and how RAM prices are affecting Steam Machine and the Steam VR Headset, Steam Frame.
title: Valve on Steam Controller Pricing, the RAM Shortage, and the Latest on Steam Deck 2

author: IGN
description:
The Steam Controller is real and it's here! Valve was gracious enough to send over their new and improved Steam Controller to go hands-on before it releases to the wild. We take it out of its relatively simple packaging to and put it to the test in several games, how it functions with Steam Big Picture Mode, and more.

#ign #gaming
title: The New Steam Controller Unboxing

author: IGN
description: The Steam Controller is excellent for both casual PC gamers and custom control enthusiasts. It offers high-end features, like TMR thumbsticks, HD haptics, and its unique dual touchpads, at a price closer to the base console controllers than its premium competitors. After two weeks of testing, it's the new PC gaming controller to beat.
title: Steam Controller Review

author: IGN
description: Don't miss The Shadow Update Launch Trailer for Ball x Pit, a brick-breaking action survival roguelite game developed by Kenny Sun and Friends. Players can now access a suite of new content with the latest update, bringing new game-altering balls, new playable characters, four passives, and more to explore. The Shadow Update for Ball x Pit is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, iOS, Android, and PC (Steam).
title: Ball x Pit - Official The Shadow Update Launch Trailer

author: IGN
description: Check out the Riven Tides Update Overview Trailer for ARC Raiders, the hit third-person extraction shooter developed by Embark Studios. Players can get a look at the upcoming map with Riven Tides that lies on the Western coast of the Rust Belt. Explore points of interest across the map alongside new enemies, events, items, cosmetics, and more. The Riven Tides Update for ARC Raiders is launching on April 28 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: ARC Raiders - Official Riven Tides Update Overview Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the First Look Featurette for Masters of The Universe, an upcoming live-action adventure movie based on Mattel’s classic 80’s toy brand. Masters of The Universe stars Nicholas Galitzine, Camila Mendes, Alison Brie, James Purefoy, Morena Baccarin, Jóhannes Haukur Jóhannesson, Charlotte Riley, featuring Kristen Wiig as the voice of “Roboto” with Jared Leto and Idris Elba. Hear from the cast on bringing the 80s phenomenon to the big screen in theaters on June 5, 2026.

In Masters of The Universe, Director Travis Knight brings the legendary franchise back to the big screen in this epic live-action adventure. After being separated for 15 years, the Sword of Power leads Prince Adam (Nicholas Galitzine) back to Eternia where he discovers his home shattered under the fiendish rule of Skeletor (Jared Leto). To save his family and his world, Adam must join forces with his closest allies, Teela (Camila Mendes) and Duncan/Man-At-Arms (Idris Elba), and embrace his true destiny as He-Man
title: Masters of the Universe - Official First Look Featurette (2026) Nicholas Galitzine, Jared Leto

author: IGN
description:
Get a look at the Release Date Trailer for Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes, a strategy roguelike game developed by Alt Shift. Players will assume control over the fleets that are seeking refuge from the Twelve Colonies. Manage the crew, deploy critical repairs, and explore the world of Battlestar Galactica. Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes is launching on May 11 for PC (Steam and GoG).

#ign #gaming
title: Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes - Official Release Date Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Kill your captors. Rescue the others. Record every second of your revenge. Better Than Dead gets a new trailer and a release date announcement. Watch the latest Better Than Dead release date announcement trailer for this upcoming bodycam FPS game. The new trailer for Better Than Dead showcases action-packed gameplay, urban environments, and more. Better Than Dead will be available on PC on May 12, 2026.

Set across a series of photorealistic locations inspired by classic Hong Kong action cinema, Better Than Dead puts players in the role of a survivor who’s done suffering. Armed with a pistol and a clear objective, every level is a direct, no-nonsense assault-fast, violent, and personal.
title: Better Than Dead - Official Release Date Trailer

author: IGN
description: Check out the Behind-the-Scenes Trailer for The Henchmen, a top-down open-world crime sandbox shooter developed by Alex Von Bronx. Players will take on the dangers of a sprawling city as they live out the life of crime. Engage in intense police chases, find hidden collectibles, and overcome optional challenges. The Henchmen is launching on May 26 for PC (Steam).
title: The Henchmen - Official Behind-the-Scenes Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Get ready to clean up in a galaxy far, far away... Watch the latest PowerWash Simulator 2 trailer for a peek at what you can expect with the Star Wars Pack, featuring iconic Star Wars locations. The Star Wars Pack for PowerWash Simulator 2 will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC, Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch 2 in summer 2026.

Set during the events of the original Star Wars trilogy, players will take on the role of class five labor droid, P0-W2. Wielding an exclusive powerwasher designed specifically for the pack, they’ll visitsix iconic locations from the Star Wars galaxy, spanning from Hoth, to Tatooine and more to be revealed.

So far, three jobs have been annonced, including the foundational Lars Homestead, the X-wing, and Super Star Destroyer Bridge.
title: PowerWash Simulator 2 - Official Star Wars Pack Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description:
It’s time to relive the best and experience the last. Watch the trailer for Jackass: Best and Last, an upcoming comedy movie starring Johnny Knoxville, Steve-O, Chris Pontius, Wee Man (Jason Acuña), Dave England, Danger Ehren (Ehren McGhehey), Preston Lacy, Rachel Wolfson, Jasper, Dark Shark (Compston Wilson), Poopies (Sean McInerney), and Zach Holmes.

Johnny Knoxville and the gang return for one final fling at the big screen. Featuring all-new stunts and stupidity along with the greatest hits and biggest laughs from the past, Jackass: Best and Last is a joyously raucous celebration of all the mischievous camaraderie that you’ve come to love and expect from these idiots over the past 25 years. 

Jackass: Best and Last, directed by Jeff Tremaine, opens in theaters on June 26, 2026.
title: Jackass: Best and Last - Official Trailer (2026) Jognny Knoxville, Steve-O, Chris Pontius

author: IGN
description:
Saros is a punishing bullet-hell experience that demands precision, speed, and a deep understanding of its rhythmic combat. Navigating the world of Carcosa is no easy feat, but whether you are struggling to master the Perfect Reload or trying to manage the corruption of the Eclipse, we’ve got you covered. In this guide, we break down 13 essential tips, from armor matrix upgrades to color-coded projectile strategies — that will help you turn the tide of battle and keep your adrenaline at max level.

Learn the best ways to utilize Alt-Fire mechanics, manage your Lucenite currency, and unlock the game-changing Second Chance ability as early as possible. This Saros gameplay guide covers essential survival strategies for both beginners and veterans, including a deep dive into Carcosan Modifiers and how to balance risk and reward when dealing with corrupted artifacts. Master the systems of this fast-paced roguelike and prepare yourself for the deadly challenges that await in the Nightmare S
title: Saros: 13 Essential Tips to Survive on Carcosa

author: IGN
description:
Check out the haunting beginning of Saros, Housemarque's follow up to 2021's Returnal. Saros is a third person shooter roguelite set on the alien planet of Carcosa, where our lead character, Arjun Devraj (played by Rahul Kohli), is part of an emergency team to find out what happened to the previous three expeditions sent ot the planet.

#ign #gaming
title: The First 8 Minutes of Saros Gameplay

author: IGN
description:
Returnal and Saros share a lot in common: They're both third person shooters set on a hostile and creepy alien planet, they're both developed by Housemarque, and they're both roguelites that are built on the idea of requiring multiple runs into order to get strong enough to reach the end. That said, there are a bunch of key differences between the two games that make their style of gameplay very different. Here's a breakdown of those differences so Returnal fans can know what they're getting into when they start Saros.

#ign #gaming
title: The Biggest Differences Between Saros and Returnal

author: IGN
description:
Astro Burn is a delightfully bonkers cute-’em-up, a love letter to 90s classics like Parodius and Pop’n TwinBee.
Play as Astro, a sassy space cat, alongside her over-chatty robot companion on a wild journey home. Blast through waves of adorable enemies across a variety of levels, from deep space to underwater worlds, stacking outrageous anime-style power-ups to unleash chaotic, screen-filling destruction in true modern retro fashion.

author: IGN
description: It wasn’t until I’d toppled the first few of Karma Exorcist’s brutal bosses that I finally got my hands on its game-changing grappling hook, but this stunning 2D Metroidvania actually got its hooks into me from the outset. At a recent BiliBili: First Look event in Shanghai, I was completely taken aback by Karma Exorcist’s stunning hand-drawn environments, sizeable cast of challenging enemies, and the expanding set of addictive abilities possessed by its stylish demon-slaying lead. Karma Exorcist has instantly gone to the top of the list of my most-wanted Metroidvanias, and with a bit more polish it just might have the goods to challenge the modern greats of the genre. Previewed by Tristan Ogilvie.
title: Karma Exorcist is a Chinese Mythology Metroidvania That Caught Me Off Guard
